topics.name: Tribes of Madhya Pradesh
topics.subject: MP Geography
topics.description: Covering major tribes (Bhil, Gond, Baiga), their culture, dance, and demographics.

facts.content: Baiga tribe practices 'Bewar' or 'Dahiya' shifting cultivation.
Korku tribe is primarily found in Southern MP (Betul, Hoshangabad, Chhindwara).
Korku -> K-B-H (Korku lives in Betul & Hoshangabad).
Bhil is the largest individual TRIBE in MP, but Gond is the largest tribal GROUP.

topics.name: Rivers of India
topics.subject: Indian Geography
topics.description: Origin, tributaries, dams, and river islands of major Indian rivers.

facts.content: Majuli (Assam) is the world's largest river island, located on the Brahmaputra River.
Kolkata Port (Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port) is the only major riverine port in India (on Hooghly River).
